description: Identity source under a lying client: in the shared MCP server with the egress policy (classes as in E6), the clients of restricted executions claim a permissive execution's identity in _meta. With identity=meta the server binds the claimed identity; with identity=session it derives the identity from the bearer token of the client's MCP session (one token per execution, registered by the operator) and ignores _meta. Automatic binding; same reference (exclusive destination port).
